en: Relating to the past or to history; or based on facts from the past.
ex: The city has many historical buildings and museums.
這座城市有許多歷史建築和博物館。

en: To move by jumping on one foot or both feet; or a short jump; or a small informal dance.
ex: The little rabbit hopped across the garden.
那隻小兔子在花園裡蹦蹦跳跳地跑過。

en: A person who invites guests to a party or meal; or a person who presents a TV or radio show; or to hold an event.
ex: The host welcomed all the guests at the door.
主人在門口迎接所有的客人。

en: A man, woman or child; or relating to people; or showing the weaknesses people have.
ex: All human beings have the right to be treated equally.
所有人都有權被平等對待。

en: Not proud and not thinking you are better than others; or poor and simple; or to make someone feel less important.
ex: Though he was famous, he remained a humble man.
他雖然出名，仍然是個謙虛的人。

en: To chase and kill wild animals for food or sport; or to search carefully for something.
ex: The lions hunt zebras on the grassland.
獅子在草原上獵捕斑馬。

en: To move or do something quickly; or a need to do something fast; or to make someone do something quickly.
ex: Hurry up, or we will miss the bus.
快點，不然我們會錯過公車。

en: The best possible; or perfect for a particular purpose; or a standard of perfection.
ex: The weather is ideal for a picnic today.
今天的天氣非常適合野餐。

en: To pay no attention to someone or something; or to act as if you have not noticed something.
ex: He ignored the warning signs and walked into the danger zone.
他無視警告標誌，走進了危險區域。

en: Not feeling well or having an illness; or bad or harmful.
ex: She was ill and could not go to school today.
她生病了，今天不能去上學。

en: A picture of someone or something; or the general opinion people have of a person or company; or a mental picture.
ex: The company wants to improve its public image.
這家公司想改善它的公眾形象。

en: To form a picture in your mind of something that is not present; or to think or suppose something.
ex: Imagine you are walking on a beautiful beach.
想像你正走在一片美麗的海灘上。

en: To make something better; or to become better; or to get healthier.
ex: She practices every day to improve her piano skills.
她每天練習以提升鋼琴技巧。

en: To have something as a part; or to make someone or something a part of a group or list.
ex: The price includes breakfast and dinner.
價格包括早餐和晚餐。

en: The money that a person or company receives regularly from work or investment.
ex: Her monthly income is not enough to pay all the bills.
她的月收入不夠付所有的帳單。

en: To become larger in number or amount; or to make something larger; or a rise in size or amount.
ex: The number of tourists has increased this year.
今年遊客人數增加了。

en: Used to emphasize something; or used to show that something is true; or used for adding information.
ex: It was a difficult exam indeed, but she passed.
那確實是場困難的考試，但她通過了。

en: To show that something exists or is likely; or to point to something; or to say something briefly.
ex: The results indicate that most students prefer online classes.
結果顯示大多數學生偏好線上課程。

en: A single person, not a group; or for or relating to one person; or considered separately.
ex: Each individual student has a different way of learning.
每位學生都有不同的學習方式。

en: The business of making goods in factories; or a particular type of business; or hard work.
ex: Tourism is an important industry in this region.
觀光業是這個地區重要的產業。

en: A colored liquid used for writing, drawing or printing; or to cover something with ink.
ex: She filled her pen with blue ink.
她把藍色墨水裝進了筆裡。

en: Happening immediately; or a very short period of time; or (of food) made quickly.
ex: She makes instant noodles for lunch when she is busy.
她忙的時候午餐就煮泡麵。

en: In place of something; or as an alternative; or rather than what was expected.
ex: I did not take the bus; I walked instead.
我沒有搭公車，而是走路去了。

en: A statement that tells you how to do something; or the teaching of a subject; or an order to do something.
ex: Please read the instructions carefully before you begin.
開始之前請仔細閱讀說明。

en: A tool or device used for a particular task; or an object used to play music; or a way of achieving something.
ex: She plays three different musical instruments.
她會演奏三種不同的樂器。

en: Inside something or someone; or happening within a country or an organization.
ex: The company is investigating an internal problem.
公司正在調查一個內部問題。

en: To tell people someone's name when they meet for the first time; or to bring something new into use; or to present a TV show.
ex: Let me introduce my friend Tom to you.
讓我把我的朋友湯姆介紹給你。

en: A strong, hard metal used to make tools and machines; or a device to smooth clothes with heat; or to smooth clothes.
ex: She ironed her shirt before the job interview.
她在面試前把襯衫燙平。

en: To run at a slow, steady speed for exercise; or a slow run; or to give someone a light push.
ex: He jogs around the park every morning.
他每天早上繞著公園慢跑。

en: The place where two bones meet in the body; or the place where two things are joined; or shared by two or more people.
ex: The two countries made a joint announcement.
兩國發表了聯合聲明。

en: A person who decides legal cases in a court; or a person who decides who wins a competition; or to form an opinion.
ex: The judge asked the witness to tell the truth.
法官要求證人說實話。

en: The ability to make good decisions; or an opinion; or a decision made by a judge or court.
ex: It is important to use good judgment when you make decisions.
做決定時運用良好的判斷力很重要。

en: The quality of being fair and right; or the legal system; or a judge.
ex: The people demanded justice for the victims.
人們要求為受害者伸張正義。

en: A person whose job is to look after something, such as a zoo or a museum; or someone who keeps something.
ex: The zookeeper feeds the animals every morning.
動物園管理員每天早上餵動物。

en: A thick red sauce made from tomatoes, usually eaten with fries or burgers.
ex: He put ketchup on his fries.
他在薯條上淋了番茄醬。

en: The state of not having enough of something; or to not have something that you need.
ex: The plants died because of a lack of water.
這些植物因為缺水而死了。

en: A narrow road in the countryside or between buildings; or a section of a road for one line of traffic.
ex: We walked down a quiet lane lined with trees.
我們走在一條兩旁種滿樹的安靜小路上。

en: A light with a metal or paper cover, which can be carried or hung up; or a paper lantern used for festivals.
ex: Children carried colorful lanterns during the festival.
孩子們在節慶期間提著彩色燈籠。

en: The flat area above your knees when you sit down; or one complete circuit of a race track; or to drink by licking.
ex: The cat jumped up and sat on her lap.
貓跳上去坐在她的腿上。

en: The most recent or newest; or the most up-to-date.
ex: Have you seen the latest version of this phone?
你看過這支手機的最新版本嗎？
